text:
Alex: rolling out engine-v3.14-kquant-2026-03-21 to night-bucket now. starting tiny canary (5%) for 30m, pin TTL=30m. release notes gist: https://gist.local/rw/engine-v3.14
Priya: ack. which quant profile are we using for the canary?
Alex: using q8_fast with fp fallback. build tag q8f-20260321-rc2.
Marta: can we add a latency SLO smoke check after first 100 requests? if p95 > 120ms, we abort and pin back.
Ryan: add memory headroom check too — last time the v3.13 bundle had a kv-cache bump. p90 memory > 82% => rollback.
Alex: agreed. smoke checks: p95 latency, p90 memory, error-rate spike > 1.5x baseline.
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rollout for engine-v3.14-kquant-2026-03-21 -> night-bucket (canary 5%)
deploy-bot: rollout id=rb-7345678901-01, pinned=false, ttl=1800s
Priya: tagging observability alert runbook: ops/runbooks/engine-canary.yaml — notify @oncall-liz if thresholds breached.
Liz: oncall here. I'll watch dashboards. please post the exact smoke queries for me.
Marta: smoke queries pasted:
```
latency.p95(filter:bucket=night)*1000
memory.p90(filter:hostgroup=engine-night)
error.rate(1m)
```
If any of these cross the thresholds, reply with "rollback" to this thread.
Ryan: add a canary traffic drain plan: at t+10m if stable, move to 20%, at t+20m 50%, t+30m full. if unstable, immediate drain to 0% and pin previous bundle.
Alex: noted. I'm also updating the release-notes doc with the fallback ABI and known incompatibilities (KV cache layout change). link in the gist.
Priya: one more: we should set a temporary routing policy that prefers engine-compat-v2 for customer-facing low-latency routes during canary. fallback in 60s.
Alex: done. routing tag engine-routing:prefer=compat-v2 for routes /v1/generate.lowlatency
deploy-bot: [smoke] initial samples collected (n=120). p95=98ms, p90 memory=64%, error-rate=0.2% — all within thresholds :thumbsup:
Liz: good so far. continuing to monitor.
Marta: note for postmortem: capture a perf histogram of kv-cache warms during first 15m. can we persist sample ids?
Alex: adding kv-sample header to trace: x-kv-sample-id.
Ryan: release-notes callout: customers on Dedicated should be informed about transient perf variability during rollout window. small blurb ready.
Alex: posting final release notes update and marking the deploy as "in-progress - canary stable". moving to 20% at t+10m per plan.
deploy-bot: [rollout] scaled to 20% (rb-7345678901-01). next checkpoint at t+20m.
Priya: thanks all. if anyone sees an anomaly reply with "rollback" so deploy-bot can act.
Liz: saw a tiny error spike at t+8m (0.9% -> 1.6%). keeping an eye, not yet >=1.5x baseline threshold.
Marta: watch for correlated GC bursts.
Alex: if spike crosses threshold we do immediate drain, pin runtime to engine-v3.13-hotfix-20260210 and open rollback PR.
deploy-bot: heartbeat OK. next autoscale check in 8m.
Priya: also tag the change window in release-calendar and email partners group for Dedicated customers.
Ryan: copy. prepping the rollback notes incase.
Alex: thanks team — I'll update thread with final status after full rollout. :rocket:
